title.zh: Nasdaq, Boerse Stuttgart, others ask EU to remove or increase cap in tokenization trial
title.en: Nasdaq, Boerse Stuttgart, others ask EU to remove or increase cap in tokenization trial

current_state.zh: 以纳斯达克、Boerse Stuttgart为首的欧洲金融与代币化团体已于9月7日致函欧盟立法者，要求取消或大幅提高拟议的1000亿欧元代币化证券上限，并提议若保留上限则至少设为5000亿欧元。
current_state.en: European finance and tokenization groups led by Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart sent a Sept 7 letter to EU lawmakers urging removal or a substantial increase of the proposed €100 billion cap on tokenized securities, proposing at least €500 billion as a baseline if a cap is retained.

updates.title_zh: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
updates.title_en: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
updates.what_changed_zh: 欧洲金融与代币化团体（包括纳斯达克、Boerse Stuttgart等）于9月7日致函欧盟理事会成员及欧洲议会经济与货币事务委员会，要求取消拟议的1000亿欧元代币化证券上限，或至少将其提高至5000亿欧元作为基线；信中提及部分现有欧洲项目规模已达3500亿欧元，并对比美国无上限的代币化结算平台。
updates.what_changed_en: European finance and tokenization groups including Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart sent a draft letter dated Sept 7 to EU Council members and the European Parliament's ECON committee, urging removal of the proposed €100 billion cap on tokenized securities or raising it to at least €500 billion as a baseline; the letter cites existing European projects already at €350 billion scale and contrasts the US where a dominant settlement platform tokenizes assets without volume caps.
updates.current_state_zh: 以纳斯达克、Boerse Stuttgart为首的欧洲金融与代币化团体已于9月7日致函欧盟立法者，要求取消或大幅提高拟议的1000亿欧元代币化证券上限，并提议若保留上限则至少设为5000亿欧元。
updates.current_state_en: European finance and tokenization groups led by Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart sent a Sept 7 letter to EU lawmakers urging removal or a substantial increase of the proposed €100 billion cap on tokenized securities, proposing at least €500 billion as a baseline if a cap is retained.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: European finance and tokenization groups, including Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart, are urging EU lawmakers to remove or substantially raise the proposed €100 billion cap on tokenized securities, proposing at least €500 billion as a baseline.
updates.detailed_summary_en: European finance and tokenization groups, including Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart, are urging EU lawmakers to remove or substantially raise the proposed €100 billion cap on tokenized securities, proposing at least €500 billion as a baseline.
